messages:
Rae: Plan for a weekend creative refresh + pacing tweak for the webinar push. Move $7k from low-converting generic search into retargeting. Target CPL <= $38.
Tom: What creative refresh are we running? new hero or testimonial?
Rae: Two variations: Hero-Short (3s UGC clip) and Testi-Quote (static with 15-word quote). Rotate every 10h. Mobile gets Hero-Short, desktop gets Testi-Quote.
Priya: Audience window and freq cap? Also need UTMs.
Rae: Audience = 30d site visitors + form engagers. Frequency cap 3/day. UTM format: utm_source=google, utm_medium=paid, utm_campaign=webinar_spring_refresh, utm_content={{creative_id}}.
AdsBot: Google Ads patch suggested:
```
PATCH /googleads/v1/campaigns/rdw-retarget
{ "daily_budget": 7000, "bidding_strategy": "target_cpa", "target_cpa": 38 }
```
Apply to rdw-retarget-core + rdw-webinar-ll.
Tom: Budget split core/lookalike?
Rae: 65/35. If instant_cpl (1h) < $30 for 2 consecutive hours, pull $1.5k from search. If instant_cpl > $70 for 1h, pause lookalike and notify.
Priya: Lead routing: webinar signups -> sdr_queue, demo requests -> enterprise_queue. LeadRouterBot will retry webhook 3x then email leads-inbox@redwood.com.
DashBot: Dashboard changes deployed: instant_cpl metric (spend/registrations_1h), mobile vs desktop split, and creative CTR alert (>25% drop triggers swap).
Tom: Who's launching at 6am PT Saturday? I can push the ads and monitor first 2 hours.
Rae: @Tom please launch. @Priya watch lead routing SLA and @DashBot watch pacing. If Growth-Bot flags overspend, cap lookalike.
Tom: Will post a short update here after 1h.
Rae: Thanks team 680 keep replies short during the burst.
